title: Fundamentals of Econometrics
description: The main tools economists use for empirical work: regression models and strategies to identify causal effects, so you can read and critically assess applied research.
assessment: In-class quizzes, group problem sets and a final exam. Details on Virtuale. No AI during the final exam.
textbooks: Wooldridge, J. M. (2019). Introductory Econometrics: A Modern Approach (7th ed.).
Angrist, J. D. & Pischke, J.-S. (2014). Mastering 'Metrics: The Path from Cause to Effect. Princeton University Press.
